title: Low Carb Ground Turkey Skillet with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Over medium-high heat, coat the bottom of your skillet with olive oil (approx 2T) and add 1lb of ground turkey. Break the turkey up using the back of a wooden spoon or a meat masher tool.
While the meat is browning, combine all spices in a small cup.
Pour the seasoning mixture over the ground turkey and cook until no longer pink, while stirring occasionally.
Finely dice 1 red bell pepper and 1 shallot. Add diced vegetables to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add in 1 cup of frozen spinach. Spinach will thaw the rest of the way in the hot skillet.
Continue cooking over medium heat for another 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently until everything is well combined and warmed through.
Cook your cauliflower rice per the package instructions.
Scoop 1 cup of rice into bowls and top with a heaping cup of the ground turkey mixture. Add shredded lettuce, pico de gallo, and siracha mayo.
